driver_of_the_day.label: +7.4 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Lando Norris scored 18 from P4 on the grid; the model expected 10.6.

best_drive_from_back.label: P21 to P12
best_drive_from_back.why: Gabriel Bortoleto gained 9 places from P21 in the 6th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +7.5 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Valtteri Bottas's 3-stop race cost 7.5 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 2.2 s stationary
fastest_stop.why: Mercedes turned Andrea Kimi Antonelli round in 2.2 s on lap 26.

overtake_of_race.label: on Max Verstappen, lap 2
overtake_of_race.why: Alexander Albon passed Max Verstappen for P9 on lap 2 despite being +1.36 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

smoothest.label: 0.332 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Franco Colapinto's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.332 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +16.3 pts v expected
team_of_weekend.why: McLaren's drivers beat the model's expectation by 16.3 points combined.
